# RunVouch

> RunVouch is the watchdog for unattended AI agents, with a tamper-evident proof per run: a dead man's switch, cost cap and outcome check for Claude Code Routines, headless `claude -p`, OpenClaw, n8n and cron'd LLM scripts. It alerts within minutes when a scheduled agent is MISSED, FAILED, reported success without evidence (NO_EVIDENCE), stuck in a RETRY_STORM, over BUDGET, DRIFTing, or STALLED. Alerts via e-mail, Telegram, Slack or webhook; PagerDuty on Team. History 7 days on Free, 90 days on Solo and Team. Free for 3 agents; $9 Solo; $29 Team. Self-hostable (MIT).

Install: `pip install runvouch` (or `curl -fsSL https://runvouch.com/rv -o ~/bin/rv && chmod +x ~/bin/rv`) then `rv agent NAME --cadence 24h --evidence` and `rv run NAME --evidence-file OUT -- your-command`.
Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add runvouch/claude-plugin` → `/plugin install runvouch`.
Claude Desktop bundle: https://runvouch.com/runvouch.mcpb
Remote MCP (official registry, com.runvouch/runvouch): `claude mcp add --transport http runvouch https://api.runvouch.com/mcp --header "X-API-Key: rv_…"`.
API base: https://api.runvouch.com (header X-API-Key).

## Docs
- [Claude Code](https://runvouch.com/docs/claude-code): Routines, headless runs, hooks plugin, transcript cost
- [Cron & scripts](https://runvouch.com/docs/cron): rv run for any job; GitHub Actions
- [Python & Node](https://runvouch.com/docs/python-node): LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI callbacks
- [Agent templates](https://runvouch.com/docs/templates): three copy-paste agents on official SEC and career-site data (DataSignals Lab), wrapped in rv run with evidence and cost caps
- [Verifiable agent runs](https://runvouch.com/verifiable-agent-runs): who needs a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent did (finance, compliance, EU AI Act logging and record-keeping duties, audits), what is and is not in the record, and how to verify it without trusting RunVouch
- [Verifiable runs](https://runvouch.com/docs/proof): every finished run gets a sha256 leaf, every UTC day a Merkle root chained to the previous day and stamped with OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin); public day files at https://api.runvouch.com/proof/, offline verifier script
- [Alert channels](https://runvouch.com/docs/alerts): e-mail, Telegram, Slack incoming webhook and JSON webhook on every plan; PagerDuty Events API v2 on Team (incident per agent and kind, resolved on ack); Solo and Team deliver MISSED and FAILED without the 10-minute cooldown
- [GitHub Actions](https://runvouch.com/docs/github-actions) · [OpenClaw](https://runvouch.com/docs/openclaw) · [n8n](https://runvouch.com/docs/n8n) · [MCP server](https://runvouch.com/docs/mcp) · [HTTP API](https://runvouch.com/docs/api)

## Field notes (blog)
- [My Claude Code cron ran up $1,800 in two nights. The watchdog that stops it at $2](https://runvouch.com/blog/claude-code-cron-unexpected-api-bill-runaway-cost-overnight): Four documented runaway agent bills ($1,818, $6,000, $437, $150), why per-call metrics hide the loop, and per-run/per-day caps with rv.
- [Claude Code Routine failed silently? How to know your scheduled agent actually ran](https://runvouch.com/blog/claude-code-routine-failed-silently-scheduled-task-didnt-run): Green does not mean done. The 4 ways a scheduled Claude Code run fails with no error, and heartbeat plus evidence checks that catch each one.
- [The dead man's switch for AI agents (and why a ping isn't enough)](https://runvouch.com/blog/dead-mans-switch-for-ai-agents): A ping monitor knows a job ran. For an agent that is the least interesting fact. What a dead man's switch has to check when the job is an LLM.
- [OpenClaw stuck in a polling loop: $150, a crash, and no alert. Detect it in 60 seconds](https://runvouch.com/blog/openclaw-stuck-in-polling-loop-150-no-alert): An OpenClaw agent called the same tool 1,535 times in two hours. Every call looked fine. How a retry-storm rule and a daily cap catch this before the bill.
- [7 ways unattended AI agents fail silently, and one check for each](https://runvouch.com/blog/7-ways-unattended-ai-agents-fail-silently): Seven ways a scheduled AI agent fails without an error, from a run that never starts to a run that does nothing, and the one detector that catches each.
- [Prove what your AI agent did: an audit trail for unattended agents](https://runvouch.com/blog/prove-what-your-ai-agent-did-audit-trail-for-unattended-agents): A real, tamper-evident proof of one agent run: hashed record, public daily Merkle chain, Bitcoin anchor. How to verify it with a stdlib script, and what it cannot prove.

## Integrations (one page per runtime: where the job runs, key as secret, snippet, what fails silently there)
- [Kubernetes CronJob](https://runvouch.com/integrations/kubernetes-cronjob): Heartbeat monitoring for Kubernetes CronJobs: MISSED when the schedule stops firing, NO_EVIDENCE when the pod exits 0 without doing the work, cost caps for LLM jobs. One line in the container command.
- [systemd timers](https://runvouch.com/integrations/systemd-timers): Heartbeat monitoring for systemd timers and oneshot services, including user timers: MISSED when the timer stops firing, FAILED with stderr when the unit fails, NO_EVIDENCE when it exits 0 and did nothing. Wrap ExecStart with rv run.
- [GitLab CI scheduled pipelines](https://runvouch.com/integrations/gitlab-ci-schedules): Heartbeat monitoring for GitLab pipeline schedules: MISSED when the schedule stops running (owner token expired, schedule deactivated), NO_EVIDENCE when the job passes without producing the artifact. One line in script:.
- [Jenkins](https://runvouch.com/integrations/jenkins): Heartbeat monitoring for Jenkins jobs with a cron trigger: MISSED when the job stops being triggered, FAILED with stderr, NO_EVIDENCE when a green build wrote nothing. No Jenkins notification plugin needed.
- [Heroku Scheduler](https://runvouch.com/integrations/heroku-scheduler): Heartbeat monitoring for Heroku Scheduler: Heroku documents Scheduler as best effort and can skip runs. RunVouch alerts when a scheduled dyno did not start (MISSED) or its task did nothing (NO_EVIDENCE).
- [AWS Lambda + EventBridge Scheduler](https://runvouch.com/integrations/aws-lambda-eventbridge): Heartbeat monitoring for scheduled Lambda functions: MISSED when the EventBridge schedule stops invoking, NO_EVIDENCE when the function returns early without doing the work, cost caps for an LLM call inside it. Two HTTP calls, no binary.
- [Google Cloud Scheduler](https://runvouch.com/integrations/google-cloud-scheduler): Heartbeat monitoring for Cloud Scheduler with Cloud Run jobs and Cloud Functions: MISSED when the scheduler job is paused or its service account loses permission, NO_EVIDENCE when the target returns 2xx without doing the work, cost caps for an LLM step.
- [Azure Functions timer trigger](https://runvouch.com/integrations/azure-functions-timer): Heartbeat monitoring for Azure Functions timer triggers: MISSED when the function app is stopped or the trigger stops firing, NO_EVIDENCE when the function completes without doing the work. Python client or two HTTP calls.
- [Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers](https://runvouch.com/integrations/cloudflare-workers-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers: two fetch() calls in scheduled() give a Worker cron a dead man's switch (MISSED), an evidence check (NO_EVIDENCE) and a cost cap.
- [Vercel Cron Jobs](https://runvouch.com/integrations/vercel-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for Vercel Cron Jobs: Vercel does not retry a failed invocation and does not notify you. RunVouch fires MISSED when the route was not called, FAILED on an error, NO_EVIDENCE when the route returned 200 without doing the work. Two fetch() calls.
- [Supabase (pg_cron + Edge Functions)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/supabase-pg-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for Supabase pg_cron jobs and scheduled Edge Functions: pg_net fires the HTTP call and forgets it. RunVouch fires MISSED when the function did not start, STALLED when it was cut off, NO_EVIDENCE when it returned without its result.
- [Render Cron Jobs](https://runvouch.com/integrations/render-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for Render Cron Jobs: wrap the command with rv run for MISSED when runs stop, FAILED with stderr, NO_EVIDENCE when the job exits 0 with nothing written, and cost caps. No extra service.
- [Railway cron schedules](https://runvouch.com/integrations/railway-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for Railway cron schedules: MISSED when the service stops being started on schedule or a run is skipped because the previous one was still going, NO_EVIDENCE when it exits 0 without doing the work, cost caps.
- [Fly.io scheduled Machines](https://runvouch.com/integrations/fly-io): Heartbeat monitoring for Fly.io: scheduled Machines and cron inside a Machine both stop silently when the Machine is destroyed, stuck or out of memory. rv run gives them MISSED, STALLED, FAILED and NO_EVIDENCE.
- [Cron inside Docker (supercronic, crond)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/docker-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for cron inside Docker containers (supercronic, BusyBox crond, ofelia): MISSED when the container is down, FAILED with stderr, NO_EVIDENCE when the command ran and produced nothing. Wrap each crontab line with rv run.
- [Apache Airflow](https://runvouch.com/integrations/airflow): Heartbeat monitoring for Apache Airflow DAGs: Airflow alerts on task failure and SLA misses. RunVouch adds MISSED when a DAG stops scheduling, NO_EVIDENCE when a green run wrote nothing, and cost caps for LLM tasks.
- [Prefect](https://runvouch.com/integrations/prefect): Heartbeat monitoring for Prefect deployments: Prefect marks runs Late when no worker picks them up. RunVouch pages you (MISSED), checks the flow produced its result (NO_EVIDENCE), and caps LLM spend per run.
- [Dagster](https://runvouch.com/integrations/dagster): Heartbeat monitoring for Dagster schedules and sensors: they stop when dagster-daemon stops. RunVouch alerts on the missing run (MISSED), checks the asset was actually produced (NO_EVIDENCE), and caps LLM cost per run.
- [Celery beat](https://runvouch.com/integrations/celery-beat): Heartbeat monitoring for Celery beat periodic tasks: beat schedules, workers execute, and when either is gone tasks silently stop. RunVouch fires MISSED on the missing run and NO_EVIDENCE on tasks that finish without their result.
- [APScheduler (in-process)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/apscheduler): Heartbeat monitoring for in-process schedulers (APScheduler, and the same shape for node-schedule): they stop when the process stops. RunVouch notices from outside with MISSED, and catches a job that ran and did nothing with NO_EVIDENCE.
- [Temporal Schedules](https://runvouch.com/integrations/temporal): Heartbeat monitoring for Temporal Schedules and workflows: Temporal guarantees the workflow will eventually run. RunVouch tells you it did not run on time (MISSED, STALLED) and that it produced what it was supposed to (NO_EVIDENCE).
- [Windmill](https://runvouch.com/integrations/windmill): Heartbeat monitoring for Windmill scheduled scripts and flows: Windmill shows its runs. RunVouch adds an outside dead man's switch (MISSED), an evidence check (NO_EVIDENCE) and an LLM cost cap.
- [Make (Integromat)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/make): Heartbeat monitoring for Make (Integromat) scenarios: Make turns a scenario off after repeated errors and e-mails you once. RunVouch keeps watching: MISSED runs, empty runs, LLM cost per run.
- [Zapier](https://runvouch.com/integrations/zapier): Heartbeat monitoring for Zapier Zaps: Zapier pauses a Zap after too many errors and can hold tasks. RunVouch fires MISSED when a scheduled Zap stops running and NO_EVIDENCE when it completes without doing the work.
- [Home Assistant automations](https://runvouch.com/integrations/home-assistant): Heartbeat monitoring for Home Assistant scheduled automations, shell commands and LLM services: MISSED when an automation stops firing after an update, FAILED when the shell command fails. Plus a REST sensor that shows RunVouch agent status inside Home Assistant.
- [LangGraph](https://runvouch.com/integrations/langgraph): Heartbeat monitoring for a LangGraph graph on a schedule: it can loop on a tool, overspend, or finish without its artifact. Wrap the run and report each tool call for RETRY_STORM, BUDGET_RUN and NO_EVIDENCE.
- [CrewAI](https://runvouch.com/integrations/crewai): Heartbeat monitoring for a scheduled CrewAI crew: wrap crew.kickoff() to cap cost per run (BUDGET_RUN), detect a crew looping on a tool (RETRY_STORM) and confirm the deliverable exists (NO_EVIDENCE).
- [AutoGen](https://runvouch.com/integrations/autogen): Heartbeat monitoring for scheduled AutoGen teams: multi-agent chats can run to max_turns without producing the result. RunVouch caps the run (BUDGET_RUN), detects loops (RETRY_STORM) and checks the output (NO_EVIDENCE).
- [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://runvouch.com/integrations/openai-agents-sdk): Heartbeat monitoring for scheduled OpenAI Agents SDK runs: wrap Runner.run() for a per-run cost cap (BUDGET_RUN), retry-storm detection on tool calls and a check that the agent produced its output (NO_EVIDENCE).
- [Pydantic AI and smolagents](https://runvouch.com/integrations/pydantic-ai): Heartbeat monitoring for a nightly Pydantic AI or smolagents script: these libraries have no scheduler and no budget. Wrapping the script with rv run gives it MISSED, FAILED, NO_EVIDENCE, DRIFT and cost caps.
- [Dify and Flowise](https://runvouch.com/integrations/dify-flowise): Heartbeat monitoring for Dify and Flowise workflows called from cron: wrap the caller with rv run so a stopped scheduler (MISSED) or an empty answer (NO_EVIDENCE) gets an alert, and pass token usage for the cost cap.
- [Ollama and local LLM batch jobs](https://runvouch.com/integrations/ollama-local-llm): Heartbeat monitoring for nightly Ollama and local LLM batch jobs: local models cost no API money, which is why nobody notices when the job stalls on a swapped-out model or writes an empty file. rv run gives it STALLED, DRIFT and NO_EVIDENCE.
- [n8n (community node)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/n8n): Heartbeat monitoring for n8n workflows on a Schedule Trigger with the n8n-nodes-runvouch community node (or two HTTP Request nodes): MISSED when the workflow stops running, NO_EVIDENCE when it ran and found nothing, cost caps per execution.
- [OpenClaw (verified-run skill)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/openclaw): Heartbeat monitoring for OpenClaw scheduled tasks: the verified-run skill wraps a task in a RunVouch run and reports the output file as evidence, so MISSED, FAILED and empty runs alert you. For the automations CLI and the gateway heartbeat, see the OpenClaw cron page.
- [Claude Code scheduled tasks](https://runvouch.com/integrations/claude-code-scheduled-tasks): Heartbeat monitoring for Claude Code on a schedule: a green Routine run means the session exited without an infrastructure error, not that the task succeeded. RunVouch fires MISSED when a run did not start, NO_EVIDENCE when it finished without its output, BUDGET_RUN when it overspent.
- [OpenClaw automations and heartbeat](https://runvouch.com/integrations/openclaw-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for OpenClaw scheduled jobs (openclaw automations, formerly openclaw cron): OpenClaw disables a recurring job after 10 consecutive failures. RunVouch fires MISSED when a job stops running, STALLED when the gateway hangs, BUDGET_DAY when an agent polls itself into a bill.
- [GitHub Actions schedule](https://runvouch.com/integrations/github-actions-schedule): Heartbeat monitoring for GitHub Actions schedule: cron workflows. GitHub disables them after 60 days without repository activity and can delay them under load; nothing tells you. The runvouch/vouch-action step gives them MISSED, FAILED and NO_EVIDENCE.
- [node-cron](https://runvouch.com/integrations/node-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for node-cron and node-schedule: the schedule lives inside your Node process and stops when it stops. RunVouch fires MISSED from outside, FAILED when the callback throws, NO_EVIDENCE when it ran and wrote nothing. Node client, no dependencies.
- [PM2 cron restart](https://runvouch.com/integrations/pm2-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for PM2 scheduled scripts (cron_restart with autorestart off): when the PM2 daemon is not resurrected after a reboot, nothing runs and nothing says so. Wrap the script with rv run for MISSED, FAILED and NO_EVIDENCE.
- [BullMQ job schedulers](https://runvouch.com/integrations/bullmq-repeatable): Heartbeat monitoring for BullMQ job schedulers and repeatable jobs: a scheduler adds jobs on a cron pattern, a Worker must process them. No Worker, evicted Redis, or a processor that resolves early, and nothing tells you. RunVouch fires MISSED, STALLED and NO_EVIDENCE.
- [Sidekiq cron (sidekiq-cron, sidekiq-scheduler)](https://runvouch.com/integrations/sidekiq-cron): Heartbeat monitoring for sidekiq-cron and sidekiq-scheduler jobs: the poller lives inside the Sidekiq process, so when it is down or the schedule failed to load, nothing is enqueued and nothing errors. RunVouch fires MISSED, FAILED and NO_EVIDENCE from two HTTP calls in perform.
- [RQ Scheduler](https://runvouch.com/integrations/rq-scheduler): Heartbeat monitoring for rq-scheduler cron jobs: a separate rqscheduler process enqueues them and an rq worker runs them. If either is missing, nothing errors. RunVouch fires MISSED on the missing run, FAILED with the exception, NO_EVIDENCE on an empty result.
- [Laravel task scheduler](https://runvouch.com/integrations/laravel-scheduler): Heartbeat monitoring for the Laravel task scheduler: everything depends on one system cron line calling schedule:run every minute. When that line is missing after a server rebuild, no task runs and no task fails. RunVouch fires MISSED, FAILED and NO_EVIDENCE per task.
- [Spring @Scheduled](https://runvouch.com/integrations/spring-scheduled): Heartbeat monitoring for Spring Boot @Scheduled methods: an exception is logged and swallowed, a hung task blocks the default single scheduler thread, and a stopped app runs nothing. RunVouch fires FAILED, STALLED and MISSED from two HTTP calls in the method.
- [Quartz Scheduler](https://runvouch.com/integrations/quartz): Heartbeat monitoring for Quartz jobs (Java, .NET): a misfire is handled by a policy, not reported; a RAMJobStore forgets every trigger on restart; a job that swallows its exception completes. RunVouch fires MISSED, FAILED and NO_EVIDENCE from two HTTP calls in execute().
- [Grafana dashboard](https://runvouch.com/integrations/grafana): Show RunVouch agent state in Grafana with the Infinity or JSON API datasource: one dashboard JSON reads the public status.json, a public fleet summary, and (with your key) /v1/agents and /v1/alerts. Import, set two variables, done.

## Compare
- [vs Healthchecks.io](https://runvouch.com/vs/healthchecks): Ping monitor vs outcome watchdog.
- [vs Cronitor](https://runvouch.com/vs/cronitor): Ops monitoring vs agent monitoring.
- [vs Langfuse](https://runvouch.com/vs/langfuse): Tracing vs watchdog, complementary.
- [vs Dead Man's Snitch](https://runvouch.com/vs/dead-mans-snitch): Heartbeat vs heartbeat plus outcome.
- [vs Sentry Crons](https://runvouch.com/vs/sentry-crons): Exceptions vs silent failures.
- [vs Better Stack](https://runvouch.com/vs/better-stack): One vendor for uptime vs one job done well.
- [vs Uptime Kuma](https://runvouch.com/vs/uptime-kuma): Self-hosted push monitor vs agent watchdog.
- [vs Cronhub](https://runvouch.com/vs/cronhub): Cron monitor vs LLM job monitor.
- [vs Helicone](https://runvouch.com/vs/helicone): LLM proxy vs outside watchdog.
- [vs AgentOps](https://runvouch.com/vs/agentops): Session replay vs pager.
- [vs LangSmith](https://runvouch.com/vs/langsmith): Tracing vs the alert that there is something to trace.
